description: C02 last state -> index grid in 1 frame; grid holds 6 frames (F4384-F4389)

Grid zooms into tile 3 "Laughter Epidemic" over 14 frames (F4390-F4403); title card (feathered colour photo of laughing schoolgirls + title; next tile title "Do…" visible at right edge) holds F4404-F4447 (44 frames)
Title card -> canvas: photo cut-out (people only, background removed, no feather) re-placed top-left (x≈.0-.4); header "Laughter Epidemic"/"January"
Date extends in place "January" -> "January, 1962" (17 frames after header)
Three cartoon schoolgirls (laughing faces, white shirts) placed bottom-left cropped at chest
Coloured school-building icon (cross on roof) placed right of girls
Africa map (cream land, label "Africa") with red-filled Tanganyika circled in black, placed right half (x≈.43-.99)
Map label "Tanganyika" placed left of circled country
Second label "Tanzania" added above "Tanganyika" (stacked modern/historic name)
Girls: all three swap to laughing poses (open red mouths, squinting eyes, hands to faces)
Middle girl's head enlarged (head-only scale up ~1.4x, a "spotlight" pop on one face)
Hard cut: header drops date; small laughing face icon + school icon placed centre (x≈.33-.39) — a symbol of "the laughter at the school"
Laughing face moves from left-of-school to on-top-of-school (instant re-place)
3-frame span: face rises slightly and holds above school
Four orange curved arrows radiating out from face (spread)
Ring of black house/building icons placed all round the school cluster (whole canvas)
Two larger black school buildings (with flags) placed left and right on the ring
Under the school: black crowd silhouettes with laughing-face icons and orange arrows, label "1.000 people affected" (European decimal point as in source)
CLOSED sign tags placed on both big schools + red curved arrow + label "14 schools closed" lower-left
Calendar icon placed bottom-right corner
Label "lasted around 18 months" placed left of calendar
Hard cut: everything cleared except laughing-face icon, re-placed centre (x≈.48)
Face icon enlarges slightly in place (3 frames after reset)
Face icon moves down a little (instant)
Red exclamation marks/dashes on both sides of the face (shock accents)
Laughing student (boy, white shirt) placed bottom-left-centre cropped at waist, holding belly
Second laughing student (tears, hands to face) placed bottom-right-centre
Clock-with-circular-arrow icon (recurring time) placed between the two students under the face
Calendar icon + 2-line label "Attacks lasting up to 16 days" placed below clock
Black pictogram lying flat (fainting, dizzy spiral) placed right of the exclamation marks
Black pictogram seated, shaking (restlessness) placed upper-right
Black pictogram running with speed lines placed top-right
Black pictogram standing, hands to throat/chest (breathing trouble) placed top-left
Black pictogram with pain marks at back (pain) placed left
Brown hand/arm with pink rash spots icon placed far-left
Black pictogram group of three people restraining/pushing placed top-left corner — symptom icons fill the canvas around the central face, 1 every ~0.8-1.1 s
Hard cut: all symptom icons, face, label cleared; the two laughing students re-placed smaller, centre (x≈.33-.55), cropped at waist
Man in mustard shirt with glasses (teacher/elder) placed left of students, hand on a student's shoulder
All three shift left ~0.05 (make room); doctor (grey coat, green gloves) placed at right edge, hand on chin
3-frame span: mustard man pose swap (hand off shoulder, hands on hips, worried look)
Doctor pose swap to open palm speaking; black hand with blood drop (poison/injury) icon placed top-left of centre
Red X struck over the hand icon
Black germ/virus cluster icon placed right of struck hand
Red X struck over germ cluster
Small black virus icons placed further right top (next candidate)
Red X struck over the virus icons (3rd ruled-out cause; X follows each candidate ~0.3-0.4 s after it appears)
Tall man in long tan coat (glasses, gesturing) enters left edge, cropped at waist, pushing group right
3-frame span: whole group (mustard man, students) + icons shift right; doctor shifts right partly out of frame (eased)
3-frame span: black crowd silhouette placed top-centre above group
Head silhouette with brain + yellow lightning (stress) placed on top of the crowd
Laughing-face icon with yellow warning triangle placed right of crowd

7-frame span: header label "Tanganyika Independence" + two archive postage stamps (flag/soldier stamp, crest stamp) placed over centre; laughing face shifts down with red arrow pointing to it (cause -> effect)
Hard cut: everything cleared; doctor/professor (grey suit, open book) placed centre-right, raised index finger; laughing face with warning triangle at his shoulder
Face+triangle icon nudged left/up (instant)
Face+triangle nudged again (small up-left step) — 3 small nudges over F5943/F5947 = slight drift
Professor pose swap to pointing left; black pictogram (person under pressure, arms up, papers/blocks falling) placed lower-left
Coloured teacher-with-pointer + 2 pupils + check mark icon placed top-left
Thought bubble with graduation cap + diploma placed right of teacher icon
Professor: pointing left -> index finger up
Blue line-art anxious girl icon + red arrow pointing at laughing face placed right
Line-art girl icon replaced by full-colour girl face (curly hair, yellow top) — style upgrade in place
Yellow lightning/stress marks around the girl
